cases.title: Stable response
cases.reason: Existing title and open status remain supported.

cases.title: Extra field
cases.reason: An extra owner field must not change the displayed task.

cases.title: Renamed title
cases.reason: The API intentionally replaces title with displayName.

cases.title: New status value
cases.reason: The intended in_progress status needs a readable label instead of Unknown.

cases.title: Zero is a valid value
cases.reason: The numeric contract is unchanged. Priority 0 means Critical, not missing.

cases.title: Unsupported payload
cases.reason: A different response shape must stop with an explicit error.
